rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose way to describe moving without being noticed, such as quietly entering somewhere.

example.english: I sneak into the classroom because I don't want anyone to see me.
example.traditional: 我偷偷哋入咗課室，唔想畀人見到。
example.jyutping: ngo5 tau1 tau1 dei6 jap6 zo2 fo3 sat1 m4 soeng2 bei2 jan4 gin3 dou2

rows.note: Use this when something is actually taken or stolen secretly, rather than when a person is merely moving stealthily.

example.english: Someone managed to sneak away with my phone.
example.jyutping: jau5 jan4 tau1 zau2 zo2 ngo5 bou6 sau2 gei1

rows.traditional: 偷偷哋帶 A 畀 B
rows.jyutping: tau1 tau1 dei2 daai3 A bei2 B
rows.note: Use this when secretly bringing an item to another person.

example.english: I sneak a document to Ming without anyone knowing.
example.traditional: 我偷偷哋帶份文件畀阿明，唔想俾人知。
example.jyutping: ngo5 tau1 tau1 dei6 daai3 fan6 man4 gin6 bei2 aa3 ming4 m4 soeng2 bei2 jan4 zi1
